summary: The tracing interceptor does not implement methods for standalone activities, preventing client-side spans from being created when executing activities. A PR has been proposed to add ExecuteActivity support to the tracing interceptor.
userImpact: Users cannot see client-side traces when executing standalone activities, reducing observability and making debugging harder.
rootCause: tracingClientOutboundInterceptor does not implement the new interceptor methods required for standalone activities.
proposedFix: Add ExecuteActivity support to tracingClientOutboundInterceptor to create StartActivity spans and write tracing context to headers.
keyQuote: tracingClientOutboundInterceptor does not currently implement the new interceptor methods related to standalone activities
